verses.he: גַּם־הַ֭יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑י יָ֝דִ֗י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל־אַנְחָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Even to-day is my complaint bitter; My hand is become heavy because of my groaning.
Oh that I knew where I might find Him, That I might come even to His seat!

verses.he: אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְפָנָ֣יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝פִ֗י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
verses.en: I would order my cause before Him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.he: אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָבִ֗ינָה מַה־יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽי׃
verses.en: I would know the words which He would answer me, And understand what He would say unto me.

verses.he: הַבְּרָב־כֹּ֖חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י לֹ֥א אַךְ־ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽי׃
verses.en: Would He contend with me in His great power? Nay; but He would give heed unto me.

verses.he: שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑וֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝נֶ֗צַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי׃
verses.en: There the upright might reason with Him; So should I be delivered for ever from my Judge.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְ֝אָח֗וֹר וְֽלֹא־אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Behold, I go forward, but He is not there, And backward, but I cannot perceive Him;

verses.he: שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ וְלֹא־אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: On the left hand, when He doth work, but I cannot behold Him, He turneth Himself to the right hand, but I cannot see Him.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑י בְּ֝חָנַ֗נִי כַּזָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: For He knoweth the way that I take; When He hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

verses.he: בַּ֭אֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑י דַּרְכּ֖וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְלֹא־אָֽט׃
verses.en: My foot hath held fast to His steps, His way have I kept, and turned not aside.

verses.he: מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָיו וְלֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝חֻקִּ֗י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי־פִֽיו׃
verses.en: I have not gone back from the commandment of His lips; I have treasured up the words of His mouth more than my necessary food.

verses.he: וְה֣וּא בְ֭אֶחָד וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַיָּֽעַשׂ׃
verses.en: But He is at one with Himself, and who can turn Him? And what His soul desireth, even that He doeth. .

verses.he: כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑י וְכָהֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For He will perform that which is appointed for me; And many such things are with Him.

verses.he: עַל־כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Therefore am I affrighted at His presence; When I consider, I am afraid of Him.
Yea, God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath affrighted me;
Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did He cover the thick darkness from my face.
